narrativeAuthority.headline: Find local makers and suppliers for your next order.

en.visitor: Explore what businesses sell, make and grow. See each business’s product range, collections, options and story together, along with the availability it lists. Find what interests you, then contact the business directly—without digging through social posts.
en.business: Whether you sell online or from a shop, make products or grow them, give your business a showroom worth sharing. Bring your brand, story and range together in one organized place. Share one link so customers can explore what you offer and contact you directly.
en.transport: Need help moving a purchase or business goods? Choose a logistics service provider and share pickup and destination in chat. A live agent for that provider can discuss the shipment; if the team is busy, leave contact details for follow-up. Verify your email in Shipment records to view entered route stages and any external provider links.
en.comingSoon: MirtPage is coming soon: digital showrooms for what businesses sell, make and grow. Website and Android launch details will follow after final review.

am.visitor: ንግዶች የሚሸጡትን፣ የሚሠሩትንና የሚያበቅሉትን ይመልከቱ። ምርቶቻቸውን፣ ስብስቦቻቸውን፣ አማራጮቻቸውንና ታሪካቸውን፣ ስለ ምርት አቅርቦት ካስቀመጡት መረጃ ጋር በአንድ ቦታ ያግኙ። የቆዩ የማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ ልጥፎችን ሳይፈትሹ፣ የፈለጉትን መርጠው ንግዱን በቀጥታ ያነጋግሩ።
am.business: በኦንላይንም ሆነ በሱቅ ቢሸጡ፣ ምርት ቢሠሩም ሆነ ቢያበቅሉ፣ ለንግድዎ ማጋራት የሚያስደስት ማሳያ ገጽ ይፍጠሩ። የንግድዎን መለያ፣ ታሪክና ምርቶች በአንድ የተደራጀ ቦታ ያቅርቡ። ደንበኞች የሚያቀርቡትን ለማወቅና በቀጥታ ለማነጋገር አንድ ሊንክ ያጋሩ።
am.transport: የገዙትን ዕቃ ወይም የንግድ ዕቃ ለማጓጓዝ እርዳታ ይፈልጋሉ? የሎጂስቲክስ አቅራቢ መርጠው መነሻና መድረሻውን በቻት ያሳውቁ። የመረጡት አቅራቢ የቀጥታ ወኪል ስለ ጭነቱ ያነጋግርዎታል፤ ቡድኑ ስራ ላይ ከሆነ መገናኛዎን ይተዉ። በጭነት መዝገቦች ገጽ ላይ ኢሜይልዎን አረጋግጠው የተመዘገቡ ደረጃዎችንና ካሉ የአጓጓዦች ሊንኮችን ይመልከቱ።
am.comingSoon: MirtPage በቅርቡ ይመጣል። ንግዶች የሚሸጡትን፣ የሚሠሩትንና የሚያበቅሉትን የሚያሳዩበት ዲጂታል ማሳያ። የድረ ገጹና የአንድሮይድ መተግበሪያው መክፈቻ ዝርዝር ከመጨረሻ ግምገማ በኋላ ይነገራል።

om.visitor: Oomishaalee dhaabbileen daldalaa gurguran, hojjetan yookaan qonnaan oomishan ilaalaa. Oomishaalee, walitti qabama, filannoowwan fi seenaa isaanii, akkasumas odeeffannoo argamuu oomishaa isaan ibsan bakka tokkootti argadhaa. Maxxansa miidiyaa hawaasaa keessa osoo hin barbaadin, waan isin barbaachisu filadhaa; ergasii dhaabbaticha kallattiin quunnamaa.
om.business: Onlaayinii yookaan suuqii keessatti yoo gurgurtan, oomisha yoo hojjettan yookaan qonnaan yoo oomishtan, daldala keessaniif fuula agarsiisaa qooduun nama gammachiisu qopheessaa. Maqaa, seenaa fi oomishaalee keessan bakka tokkootti sirnaan qindeessaa. Maamiltoonni waan isin dhiheessitan beekanii kallattiin isin quunnamuuf geessituu tokko qoodaa.
om.transport: Waan bitatte yookaan meeshaa daldalaa geejjibuuf gargaarsa barbaaddaa? Dhaabbata tajaajila loojistikii filadhuutii bakka irraa fudhatamuu fi geeffamuu karaa chaatii himi. Hojjetaan dhaabbatichaa kallattiin si waliin haasaʼa; yoo qabamanii jiran lakkoofsa kee dhiisi. Fuula Galmeewwan feʼumsaa irratti imeelii kee mirkaneessitee sadarkaalee imalaa galmaaʼan fi liinkiiwwan dhaabbilee geejjibaa yoo jiraatan ilaali.
om.comingSoon: MirtPage dhiheenyatti ni dhufa. Waan daldaltoonni gurguran, hojjetanii fi oomishan agarsiisa dijitaalaa keessatti walitti fida. Odeeffannoon marsariitii fi appii Android erga gamaaggamni xumuramee booda ni qoodama.
